title: Ukuxoshwa Kwethole Legolide
intro: Umuntu okukhulunywe ngaye kwiQuran waholela isixuku esikhulu ekuphambukeni ngesikhathi engekho umprofethi ohloniphekile. Into ethile eyenziwe ngegolide yathumba izinhliziyo zesizwe sonke - kodwa indaba yalo muntu iphela ngokuba yedwa kanye nesiqalekiso esingajwayelekile. Kungaba ngubani lo olahliwe?
clues: Ngavela ngesikhathi umprofethi omkhulu engekho owayenyukele ukuyothola isiqondiso saphezulu.
Ngabangela isixuku esikhulu ukuba siduke ngento engiyiklame ngezandla zami.
Indalo yegolide engangiyidalile yayibonakala sengathi inokuphila, ikhiqiza imisindo eyabahlaba umxhwele labo abayilandelayo.
Ngithi ngibone lokho abanye abangakwazi ukukubona — umbono obonakalayo kokungabonakali.
Ngakhipha okuthile emizileni yesithunywa saphezulu ngakufaka ensimbini encibilikisiwe.
Ngagwetshwa ukuzulazula ngedwa, nginesiqalekiso esiyingqayizivele sokuthi akekho owayengathinta isikhumba sami futhi akekho owayengathinta esakhe.

outcome.label: Umphumela
options: Ukudingiswa, ukunqatshelwa ukuthintwa noma ukuthintwa abanye
outcome.answer: Ukudingiswa, ukunqatshelwa ukuthintwa noma ukuthintwa abanye

arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدْ فَتَنَّا قَوْمَكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ ٱلسَّامِرِىُّ
verse: [Allāh] said, "But indeed, We have tried your people after you [departed], and the Sāmirī has led them astray." (20:85)
